findings.title: MobileNavDrawer z-index unspecified; portaled drawer will stack under the z-50 Header and the z-40 mobile tab bar
findings.location: Mobile drawer (src/components/MobileNavDrawer.tsx) section, plus MobileExploreTabs bottom-nav section
findings.fix: Give the backdrop and the sheet explicit z-indexes strictly greater than z-50 (Header) and z-40 (MobileExploreTabs), e.g., backdrop z-[60] and sheet z-[70]. Add a one-line note in the Mobile responsive strategy section that confirms the drawer stacks above the bottom tab bar.

findings.title: MobileExploreTabs tab buttons set aria-controls to tabpanel IDs that are not mounted
findings.fix: Pick one of two resolutions and spell it out. Option A: on inactive tabs set aria-controls={undefined} (or omit the attribute) and tabIndex={-1}, keep aria-controls only on the active tab. Option B: always render three <div role="tabpanel" id={`panel-${id}`} aria-labelledby={`tab-${id}`} hidden={active!==id}> wrappers, but only populate the active one with its slot (preserves the single-mount invariant for mapSlot).

findings.title: Overview and Invariants rows describe the URL contract as 'sizeKm' but the actual URL param is 'size'
findings.location: Overview paragraph and 'Invariants and ownership' table
findings.fix: Replace 'sizeKm' with 'size' in both places when describing URL params; keep 'sizeKm' only when referring to the AreaSelection in-memory property. Code paths unchanged (areaToParams preserved verbatim).

findings.title: SegmentedControl wrapper uses role="group" while the keyboard behaviour matches a WAI-ARIA radiogroup
findings.fix: Change the wrapper to role="radiogroup" so screen readers announce the composite and the arrow-key navigation is semantically correct. The option buttons keep role="radio" + aria-checked.

findings.title: useIsDesktop defines subscribe/getSnapshot inside the hook body, triggering add/removeEventListener on every Dashboard render
findings.location: 'Single mounted subtree per viewport' useIsDesktop listing
findings.fix: Lift the MediaQueryList and the subscribe/getSnapshot/getServerSnapshot functions to module scope, or memoise them with useCallback + a module-level MQL. Example: const DESKTOP_MQL = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)') : null; const subscribeDesktop = (cb) => { DESKTOP_MQL?.addEventListener('change', cb); return () => DESKTOP_MQL?.removeEventListener('change', cb); }; const getDesktopSnapshot = () => DESKTOP_MQL?.matches ?? true; const getDesktopServerSnapshot = () => true;

findings.title: Dashboard import diff for useSyncExternalStore and useOsmStatus not called out
findings.fix: Add a one-line import-diff note (mirroring the MapView import-diff note from iteration 2 NIT #7): 'The React import list expands to useCallback, useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore. A new import `import { useOsmStatus } from "@/components/OsmStatusContext"` is added.'

findings.title: Preset tile active-state uses bare 'data-active:' Tailwind variant while SegmentedControl uses the bracketed 'data-[active=true]:' form; the attribute wiring is also implicit
findings.fix: Standardise on the bracketed form in both places and spell out the attribute: <button data-active={active} className="... data-[active=true]:ring-2 data-[active=true]:ring-[var(--green)] data-[active=true]:ring-offset-2">.

findings.title: Methodology card copy is a hint, not verbatim text, even though the Header's /#methodology nav depends on the card existing
findings.fix: Lock down the methodology card copy as a verbatim block (same approach that iteration-2 NIT #3 applied to the hero body paragraph). Suggested two paragraphs cover the 50/30/20 weights (with re-normalisation note) and the 150 m scenario tool (with the planting-suitability disclaimer); exact wording in the review markdown.

findings.title: Drawer focus-trap selector narrows the drawer's content contract implicitly
findings.fix: Add one sentence that makes the selector contract explicit: 'Drawer contents must only be <a>, <button>, or elements with [tabindex]; introducing an <input>, <select>, or <textarea> requires widening the querySelectorAll selector in the focus-trap handler.'
